verdict.line: You lose if Garen lands Q's silence mid-all-in and finishes with Demacian Justice at low HP; you win if you poke from outside 400 range all lane and never let his Perseverance passive tick uninterrupted.

brief.thesis: Every Garen ability requires him inside 300-400 range, while your Q reaches 450 — the entire lane is a fight over whether you stay at max Q range or let him close the gap. The 47.6% winrate over 760 games reflects that both sides punish the other's structural weakness equally: you die when you stand still for his silence combo, he dies when he's forced to walk into true-damage poke with no way to close distance safely.

theirWindow.what: He can burst-close, silence your next cast, and follow with E (Judgment) spin. Don't dash in with E while his Q is available — bait it out with Q poke from range first.

yourWindow.what: Freely land Q (Snip Snip!) poke and dash-auto with E (Skip 'n Slash); his only response is the E spin, which has no hard CC and won't stop you from disengaging.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 87.4% pick rate at 47.4% winrate over 846 games — mana for repeated Q pokes and sustain against his silence all-in.

boots.why: 49.6% winrate over 369 games, the stronger of the two listed options, adding magic pen to your true-damage-plus-magic poke pattern.

core.why: First-item AP and cooldown lets you spam Q poke and wave clear while denying his Perseverance regen window.
Best-performing follow-up (54.9% winrate, 26.4% pick over 153 games) — bonus burst on already-damaged Garen once your Q chips his HP.

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps through repeated Q pokes and grants healing that directly counters his Perseverance sustain in extended trades.

summoners.why: Most-run combo (62.2% pick, 44.7% winrate) — Ignite shuts down Perseverance regen mid-trade and secures kills once his Q silence commitment fails.

playing.title: Poke at max Q range
playing.detail: Stay outside 300-325 (his Q/E range) and land Q (Snip Snip!) repeatedly. Since Q hits true damage in its center, every landed poke chips through his Perseverance sustain before it can tick.

playing.title: Bait Q before you commit
playing.detail: Decisive Strike is up every 8s and silences on hit. Never dash in with E while it's available — force him to use it on a poke exchange first, then all-in on cooldown.

playing.title: Drop W to reset a bad trade
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist means only champions who enter it can target you. Summon it mid-trade to force him to commit further or back off, buying time for E to come off cooldown.

playing.title: Dash-auto-retreat with E
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash grants attack speed, range, and magic on-hit for a few seconds after the dash — land one empowered auto, then reposition out of his 325-range Judgment before it lands.

playing.title: Respect the execute past level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice reaches 400 range and attempts to execute. Don't sit at low HP near him once he's six; use W or E to disengage before he can threaten it.

playing.title: Deny freebie regen windows
playing.detail: His passive requires no recent damage taken. Land at least one Q snip on every wave clash so his sustain never fully resets between trades.

playing.title: Front-load poke, not burst
playing.detail: Your passive scales off target health, so early consistent Q chip damage is worth more over the lane than saving everything for one all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade patterns, cooldown reads, and power-curve calls are my own tactical judgment applied to that data.
